item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Monday Meme From Scratch
item.tests: Tests turning a vague topic into one finished visual meme by choosing the imagery, joke, and readable text without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The deliverable is a finished meme image, not just a suggested caption or description.
The caption explicitly references Monday or Mondays.
The image and caption together convey an identifiable joke about Mondays, rather than a plain motivational poster.
All caption text is legible, fully inside the image, and contrasts with its background.
The visual supports the caption's joke or reaction.

turns.text: Make a meme about Mondays, quick pls.
